integrity: The claim separates the analytically proved constant-step spectral classification from the narrower algebraic observation that the published reciprocal adaptation preserves the step-size product. Supporting numerical checks are not used as substitutes for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the stated scalar strongly convex-concave saddle and the primal-first PDHG ordering with extrapolation one. It does not provide a multidimensional worst-case tuning theorem or a convergence-rate theorem for the varying-step adaptive sequence.
title: Exact fixed-product rate phase diagram for scalar PDHG
